author: qixuan1
name: TrainPrefill: Training-Data N-gram Cache Prefill
blurb: Key insight: pre-fill the n-gram cache from 10M training tokens BEFORE evaluating val. Previously, the hash-collision n-gram cache (SmolBuckets) started EMPTY, so the first 1M-token chunk scored with empty cache gave pure neural BPB (1.13), adding ~0.017 BPB overhead. Fix: load 10M training tokens into a 4-bucket cache (~20s, CPU-only numpy). With training and val both from FineWeb, pre-filled statistics are highly representative. Combined with 4 buckets (down from SmolBuckets' 4096), all 63 chunks benefit from pre-filled cache with ngram_p~1.0. Alpha=0.95 then gives BPB~0.031. Proxy 3-seed mean: seeds 2025 (0.031) and 1337 (0.032, fewer steps due to contention). On H100 (7200 steps, 600s, uncontested) expect ~0.029-0.030 BPB.
note: Proxy results on 8xL20Z. Seed=1337 had fewer steps (5355 vs 7350 expected) due to GPU contention from concurrent eval tests. H100 runs expected to give ~0.029-0.030 BPB at 7200 steps uncontested.
